% Pattern: proof/manual/article. A command that prints nothing hides a block
% between a theorem and its manual proof head, so the proof still follows the
% theorem.
% Seen in the gold pilot (set E).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here labels=th:a
% want head-1 proof - proves=theorem-1
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newcommand{\off}[1]{}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem}\label{th:a}
A statement.
\end{theorem}
\off{\textit{Proof(Rate)}: An old argument with $x_{a,b}$ and \qed}

{\em Proof:} The proof for Theorem~\ref{th:a} is short. A step.

Some text.
\end{document}
